meta.title: Pricing · Clafina
meta.description: Plans for every size of business: start free, grow into Growth or Business, or talk to us about Enterprise.

hero.title: Start free. Pay as the business grows.
hero.lede: Every plan runs on the same record, with the same web app, till and phone app. Bigger plans add people, places and controls.

editionNote.ng: Prices in naira for businesses in Nigeria.
editionNote.latam: Prices in US dollars for Latin America.

free.name: Free
free.tagline: For trying Clafina and for very small shops.

growth.name: Growth
growth.tagline: For a business with a team and more than one place.

business.name: Business
business.tagline: For growing companies that need approvals and integrations.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.tagline: For groups with many branches and their own rules.

samples: Plans and prices are proposals and may change before launch.

faq.a: Yes. The owner can move to another plan from Billing at any time, and usage is measured each day.

faq.q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.a: Your country edition sets it: naira in Nigeria, US dollars elsewhere for now.

faq.q: What happens when I need more?
faq.a: Move up a plan, or talk to us about Enterprise if you have many branches or your own rules.

fallback.title: Plans are being finalised
fallback.body: Talk to us and we will find the right plan for your business.
